paragraphs.text: Illusion is a creature type used for cards that depict incorporeal beings that are manifestations of pure thought and will. A few newer illusions represent holographic entities as well ( 3 cards ).
As the existence of Illusions is often based on the manipulation of mind magic, their attributes are variable.

Where the illusion takes a clear inspiration, "illusion" acts like a class, and it has another subtype, though many illusions are simply bizarre amalgamations that can't be described as anything else. This puts it into the short list of species/job types, alongside Zombie and Spirit .
Illusions are often aligned with blue mana , although they have appeared in all colors.

The first creatures to bear the type were Illusionary Presence and Illusionary Forces in Ice Age . However, Phantasmal Forces and Phantom Monster were later errataed to illusion, making them the first illusions in the game.
In retrospect, Mark Rosewater wished all Illusions were enchantment creatures .
In the Grand Creature Type Update the creature types Entity ( Psionic Entity ), Mistfolk ( Mistfolk ) and Phantasm (for example Phantasmal Mount ) were changed into Illusion.

Many illusions are at such odds with reality that direct contact with the material world breaks their spell and causes them to vanish or be destroyed. This can be see in the " Illusion mechanic ": when ~ becomes the target of a spell (or ability ), sacrifice it.
As they are immaterial, some illusions may be used to attack through an enemy's defenses. This is typically depicted in the game through evasion abilities such as flying or shadow .
